Analytical leadership and performance accountability ·   Lead monthly business reviews with clear variance analysis and recommendations. Izvrsno poznavanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu. Poznavanje radnih alata za vođenje projekata (npr. ClickUp) i CRM sustava (npr. HubSpot). Vještine Fokus na projekte i postizanje ciljeva koji podržavaju profitabilnost. Izvrsnost u izgradnji i održavanju odnosa s klijentima. Sposobnost učinkovitog praćenja i interpretiranja marketinških rezultata. Koja će biti tvoja zaduženja? Prodajne aktivnosti: nuditi prilagođena marketinška rješenja za povećanje uspjeha postojećih Entrio klijenata i njihovih događanja. Regionalno upravljanje klijentima: samostalno vođenje portfelja klijenata i organizatora događanja na BHS govornom području. Suradnja s maticom u Zagrebu: redovito usklađivanje, razmjena znanja i koordinacija projekata s produktnim, prodajnim i marketinškim timom u zagrebačkoj centrali. Provedba regionalnih strategija: prilagodba i lansiranje marketinških kampanja za lokalna i regionalna događanja. Redovita komunikacija: održavanje stalnog kontakta s klijentima i proaktivno predlaganje novih aktivnosti. Zadržavanje klijenata: osiguravanje dugoročne suradnje i zadovoljstva klijenata. Podrška i savjetovanje: pomaganje organizatorima, rješavanje izazova i pružanje stručnih savjeta. Koordinacija aktivnosti: provedba, koordinacija i upravljanje aktivnostima klijenata. Cross-selling i Upselling: promicanje dodatnih marketinških i srodnih usluga. Identifikacija ključnih klijenata: razumijevanje njihovih potreba i prepoznavanje prilika za rast. Interna koordinacija: bliska suradnja s internim timovima kako bi se osigurao uspjeh svakog projekta. Razvoj strategija: sudjelovanje u kreiranju prilagođenih marketinških strategija i ponuda. Upravljanje rokovima: održavanje projekata na pravom putu i unutar predviđenih vremenskih okvira. Izvještavanje: redovito izvještavanje klijenata o napretku i rezultatima kampanja. Analiza izvedbe: evaluacija uspješnosti provedenih marketinških aktivnosti. Što nudimo? Ugovor na neodređeno. Početnu neto plaću u rasponu od 2.250 do 2.500 KM (s uračunatom naknadom za topli obrok). Remote rad jednom tjedno na dan po tvom izboru. Rad na brzorastućem, međunarodnom proizvodu koji koristi više od milijun ljudi godišnje. Stalnu podršku i koordinaciju s timom u Zagrebu. Povremene odlaske u zagrebačku centralu na timska druženja, radionice i ključne regionalne događaje. Neki od osnovnih benefita: radno vrijeme od 8 do 16h / od 9 do 17h, minimalno 22 dana godišnjeg odmora, slobodan prvi dan jaslica / vrtića / škole, slobodan rođendanski dan, novogodišnji bonus, regres, pristup nekim od najboljih regionalnih događanja. Sad je vrijeme za tvoj nastup! P.S. Obožavamo video prijave. Prijavi Se Putem Video Formata - Javi Nam Se Na Job@entrio.hr, Pošalji Nam CV i Link Na Video u Kojem Te Molimo Sljedeće ukratko nam se predstavi, provedi nas kroz svoj životopis i iskustvo, koji je najbolji event na kojem si bio/la i zašto, opiši nam svoju najstresniju poslovnu situaciju koju si doživio/la, reci nam zašto želiš raditi u Entriju. Ako ti snimanje videa stvara nelagodu, u tom te slučaju molimo da se prijaviš putem ove forme i odgovoriš na nekoliko pitanja kako bismo se bolje upoznali.

review_candidates.title: Manager, Program Partnerships and Delivery
review_candidates.description: Manager, Program Partnerships and Delivery, Technology Solutions 100% Remote within California, Must reside in California The Manager, Program Partnerships and Delivery leads the expansion, implementation, and scaling of the Centralized Clinical Placement System (CCPS), a statewide platform that coordinates clinical training placements between healthcare providers and academic programs. The Manager develops strategic partnerships with hospitals, health systems, clinics, other healthcare providers, and educational institutions to expand the CCPS network, accelerate adoption, and optimize available clinical training capacity—particularly in rural and medically underserved communities. What You’ll Do Reporting to the Executive Director, Technology Solutions, the Manager leads regional engagement and translates statewide objectives into clear priorities, work plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes. The position manages executive-level relationships with partners and state agencies, collaborates with the product team to align platform delivery with program commitments, and is accountable for achieving milestones, managing risks and dependencies, and increasing partner participation. Through this work, the Manager strengthens California’s healthcare workforce pipeline by improving the coordination of clinical placements and helping more students complete the clinical experiences required to enter the healthcare workforce. The role independently manages day-to-day team, partner, and program matters while escalating signiﬁcant strategic, ﬁnancial, contractual, technical, or delivery risks as appropriate. This position is well suited for an experienced program and partnership leader with demonstrated strengths in people management, implementation, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional delivery. Build and manage relationships with healthcare providers, clinical training sites, educational institutions, and workforce partners to expand participation in CCPS Lead outreach, engagement, and representation of CCPS with hospitals, health systems, academic partners, and regional and national organizations Support onboarding and ongoing engagement of partners, including guidance on integrating CCPS into clinical placement workﬂows Maintain strong partner relationships to promote sustained adoption and eﬀective system utilization Facilitate collaboration between healthcare and education partners to improve coordination of clinical placements and support regional workforce needs Track program participation, adoption metrics, and partner engagement to identify opportunities for growth and improvement Gather partner feedback and communicate insights to internal product and technology teams Develop reports and presentations for leadership and stakeholders, along with materials that build broader program awareness Contribute to team eﬀort by completing other assignments and serving on project teams, as assigned. Attributes for Success Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, Public Health, Business Administration, Education, or a related ﬁeld, or equivalent work experience Minimum of ﬁve (5) years of experience in partnership development, program management, healthcare program implementation, or related roles Minimum of three (3) years of experience working in healthcare, clinical education, healthcare operations, or healthcare workforce initiatives Proﬁciency in Microsoft Oﬃce, Google Suite, Zoom, and other collaboration tools Experience with Atlassian products (JIRA, Conﬂuence, Product Discovery, Service Desk); JIRA for task tracking preferred Project management experience required. Agile project management experience preferred Familiarity with California Community Colleges, public education, or state agencies is a plus Experience developing partnerships or expanding participation in programs or initiatives at statewide scale Experience leveraging market research, user research, or data analysis to inform program or product decisions is a plus We’re recruiting for mission-driven, passionate, equity-minded individuals with a strong desire to impact and change people’s lives for the better Our work holds great weight and responsibility, and the opportunity to impact the lives of millions Innovation, creativity, collaboration, and entrepreneurship are encouraged as employees work to achieve organizational goals FoundationCCC blends the impact of a non-profit, the culture of an entrepreneurial start-up, and the scale of a state agency Team members are hired for their expertise in niche areas across our areas of impact and higher education overall, and for their knowledge of business, philanthropy, technology, communications, and more We have a commitment to professional development and an emphasis on shared leadership, to ensure growth for employees and the organization overall What We Offer FoundationCCC is fully committed to a “remote-first” philosophy, and recruits and hires talent across the state in fully remote positions, where virtual work is possible. Our headquarters are located in Downtown Sacramento, just blocks from California’s State Capitol. Benefits Competitive compensation, generous PTO, holidays Medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, and Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Wellness offerings CalPERS retirement program and optional 403(b) and 457 Retirement plans Tuition reimbursement Public Service Loan Forgiveness certified employer If you have any questions, please email us at jobs@foundationccc.org. Budgeted Annual Salary Pay Range $100,000.00 - $110,000.00 Final salary and rates are based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.

review_candidates.title: Manager, Global Payroll
review_candidates.description: Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services. The Finance Team includes Finance Business Partnership, Accounting, Finance Operations, Financial Systems, Internal Audit, Tax, Treasury, and Investor Relations teams. Together, the team partners with leadership to provide insights, information, and guidance to make strategic and operational decisions, advise investors about our business model and progress, and ensure the company is financially healthy and consistently meeting our reporting obligations. We’re looking for a world class Manager, Global Payroll to join team Snap! This leadership role is instrumental in leading best-in-class payroll service delivery across the Americas and APAC, while providing critical input into the overall global payroll service delivery approach. In addition to leading a regional payroll team, this leader’s focus will be multi-dimensional, with responsibility for exceptional service experience, regional and local country expertise, strong partner engagement, regulatory compliance and risk mitigation, operational process excellence, and an innovative approach to future-impacting services and solutions. The incumbent will collaborate with existing payroll professionals and forward-thinking business partners throughout the company to support Snap’s finance structure. What you’ll do: Oversee Americas and APAC payroll operations, leading a team of payroll professionals focused on timely, accurate, compliant payroll results and an exceptional service experience for regional partners and Snap team members Own end-to-end payroll delivery across multiple entities, countries, pay frequencies, and payroll calendars, including payroll inputs, calculations, approvals, funding, payments, tax remittances, reconciliations, reporting, and issue resolution Work in partnership with third-party payroll providers, tax advisors, and local country specialists to establish optimal operational and service-level expectations; foster relationships built on teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement Ensure regulatory compliance while continually monitoring and analyzing the evolving regional and local country regulatory landscape Develop a sustained state of operational audit readiness, including coordination with partners outside of Payroll Operations Maintain and improve payroll controls, including payroll approvals, gross-to-net reviews, variance analysis, headcount reconciliations, funding controls, access reviews, tax tracking, and audit evidence Partner with Accounting and Treasury on payroll funding, cash forecasting, tax payments, bank-file processes, payroll journal entries, general-ledger impacts, and balance-sheet reconciliations Ensure payroll is processed accurately and timely while accounting for funding of payroll deductions and statutory obligations to third parties, including stock-based compensation and other equity-related transactions Partner with cross-functional partners on RSU processing, benefits and deduction inputs, mobility considerations, leave-related adjustments, terminations, and final pay Partner with People Tech on Workday configuration, payroll integrations, upstream data quality, business-process changes, testing, and system enhancements Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and simplify payroll processes through dashboards, exception management, structured checklists, workflow improvements, and scalable reporting Establish clearly defined department and individual goals and objectives and communicate them to associates through department meetings and performance planning Utilize leadership and management experience to coach, train, and develop a highly focused, productive, resilient, and purpose-driven team Assist in implementing payrolls in new countries and entities, and participate in or lead cross-functional projects involving payroll migrations, acquisitions, reorganizations, system implementations, and process changes Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities: Strong knowledge of multi-state US payroll, multi-country payroll, payroll tax requirements, statutory obligations, and the impact of payroll transactions on the general ledger Workday Payroll and a global payroll platform such as PwC’s Global Payroll Platform, ADP Streamline, or a similar system; Workday experience strongly preferred Experience processing stock-based compensation and RSU-related payroll transactions, strongly preferred Experience with payroll funding, tax payments, payroll journals, reconciliations, and cash movement Experience managing payroll providers, country-level advisors, service expectations, and escalations Proven experience designing and implementing operational improvements, payroll controls, and audit-ready processes Working knowledge of payroll data quality, integrations, testing, access governance, system enhancements, and change management Strong analytical skills, including the ability to investigate variances, identify root causes, and translate findings into clear actions; Excel proficiency preferred Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines across multiple time zones Strong project management, collaboration, and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex payroll requirements, risks, decisions, and timelines to technical and non-technical stakeholders Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential employee, compensation, banking, tax, and equity information Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (Business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related discipline preferred) 7+ years of progressive payroll experience, including multi-state US payroll Regional multi-country payroll or HR experience Experience working in a multinational organization engaged in global customer delivery or similarly complex international operations Preferred qualifications: Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification Workday experience, specifically Payroll module People management experience preferred "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week. At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable). Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success! Compensation In the United States, work locations are assigned a pay zone which determines the salary range for the position. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. The starting pay may be negotiable within the salary range for the position. These pay zones may be modified in the future. Zone A (CA, WA, NYC): The base salary range for this position is $142,000-$214,000 annually. Zone B: The base salary range for this position is $135,000-$203,000 annually. Zone C: The base salary range for this position is $121,000-$182,000 annually. This position is eligible for equity in the form of RSUs. If you believe this job description is missing required pay transparency information, please submit a report through this form: Job Description Pay Range Disclosure .
